lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 84, where tall or wide highlights fit the video frame, and the crash check goes.
It has three parts: what the PR adds, how it was checked, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
Two changes to how make-video picks each frame's zoom, and one to what its status command reports.
lines.say: Two changes to how make video picks each frame's zoom, and one to what its status command reports.

lines.caption: First, the box is widened by however far a highlighted table overflows its column.
Then the zoom is picked as before: fit the screen, and at least 1.55 where the width allows.
lines.say: Then the zoom is picked as before: fit the screen, and at least one point five five where the width allows.

lines.caption: New: if the highlighted keys are too tall for the frame, the zoom goes down until they fit.
Each frame is still checked, and a zoom below 1 now counts as too small to read.
lines.say: Each frame is still checked, and a zoom below one now counts as too small to read.

lines.caption: Status now reports those problems, so CI catches them, and render still refuses them.
Three videos failed to render: one file tree was too tall, and two tables were too wide.
The zoom only drops when content would be cut off. Every other frame keeps its zoom.
The width now counts content wider than its column, like a table whose result cells don't wrap.
The highlights, with room for their outline, must fit the stage's 733 pixels of height.
lines.say: The highlights, with room for their outline, must fit the stage's seven hundred and thirty three pixels of height.

lines.caption: Status already measured every frame but threw the problems away. Now it prints them and fails.
Also folded in, issue 85: you're no longer asked for the split-view crash check after an update.
lines.say: Also folded in, issue eighty five: you're no longer asked for the split view crash check after an update.

lines.caption: The line goes from CLAUDE.md, and from the upstream-merge skill's issue and pull request.
lines.say: The line goes from claude dot M D, and from the upstream merge skill's issue and pull request.

lines.caption: Older explainers keep it, since they describe their pull requests as merged.
The PR changes the video script, its skill notes, CI's explainer script, CLAUDE.md and the upstream-merge skill.
lines.say: The PR changes the video script, its skill notes, CI's explainer script, claude dot M D and the upstream merge skill.

lines.caption: To undo it, revert the PR. Pages 55 and 64 then fail to render, and the crash check returns.
lines.say: To undo it, revert the PR. Pages fifty five and sixty four then fail to render, and the crash check returns.

lines.caption: Part 2. How it was built and verified.
Every check ran in this session with the headless Chrome that CI uses. Rendering needs Kokoro.
It builds on the problems the probe already found, and on every frame's zoom saved before the change.
Comparing all 23 explainers, only the failing frames of pages 55 and 64 changed zoom.
lines.say: Comparing all twenty three explainers, only the failing frames of pages fifty five and sixty four changed zoom.

lines.caption: Those two tables now fit, at zoom 1.30 and 1.54.
lines.say: Those two tables now fit, at zoom one point three and one point five four.

lines.caption: Page 23's tree already fits here, so a stretched copy was tested: the old code cut it off, the new one fits it.
lines.say: Page twenty three's tree already fits here, so a stretched copy was tested: the old code cut it off, the new one fits it.

lines.caption: Without the zoom fix, status fails on 55 and 64. With it, all 23 narrations pass.
lines.say: Without the zoom fix, status fails on fifty five and sixty four. With it, all twenty three narrations pass.

lines.caption: No mention of the crash check is left. The frames were checked as screenshots; the videos weren't rendered here.
A fresh review agent found no significant bugs and four low findings.
Three were fixed: useless widening is undone, a tiny zoom is a problem, and stamp lists problems.
The fourth, a small outline margin, was kept, since no current frame is affected.
CI's first review found eight findings, one of them a confirmed medium.
The medium, a zoom with no lower bound, was already fixed by the second push, along with stamp.
Five more were fixed: only the highlights can widen the frame, and the messages are clearer.
You accepted the last one: CI's fonts can differ from yours, so a frame near the edge may disagree.
After the merge, you re-render videos 23, 55 and 64 on your machine.
lines.say: After the merge, you re-render videos twenty three, fifty five and sixty four on your machine.

lines.caption: Part 3. What comes later.
No open issue builds on this one. What's left is that render.
That's pull request 84: tall or wide highlights now fit, and CI says when one wouldn't.
lines.say: That's pull request eighty four: tall or wide highlights now fit, and CI says when one wouldn't.
